title: Rename business to Skynet Services across website

requirements.text: Update the business name to "Skynet Services" across all user-facing UI locations where the current business name appears (e.g., header brand text, footer brand text, About section heading, copyright line), and update relevant logo alt text accordingly.
acceptanceCriteria: The header brand name text displays "Skynet Services" instead of "SecureConnect".
The footer brand name text displays "Skynet Services" instead of "SecureConnect".
The About section heading reads "Why Choose Skynet Services" (replacing the old name).
The footer copyright line uses "Skynet Services".
The header/footer logo image alt text references "Skynet Services" (not "SecureConnect").
No other user-facing text is unintentionally changed.

requirements.text: Update the HTML document title to use the business name "Skynet Services" (replacing the current generic/old title).
acceptanceCriteria: The browser tab title includes "Skynet Services".

constraints: Do not edit files under frontend/src/components/ui (read-only).

Do not modify frontend immutable paths (frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, frontend/src/components/ui).
nonGoals: Do not redesign the site layout or visual theme.
Do not change the generated logo/hero images or add new images.
Do not change contact placeholders like phone number, address, or email unless required solely for the business name change.
